kind: V2.0 infrared receiver hardware compatibility and long-hold repair
remote: User-provided robot vacuum remote; brand/model unknown
wiring: Onboard receiver DAT to PE6/IR_G7 via P1 pins 1-2; functional reception confirmed

diagnosis.before: Hardware release at ~102-110 ms split long holds into DOWN/UP pairs. Full frames usually ~156-157 ms apart; initial gap ~313-314 ms.
diagnosis.old_cumulative_stats: frames=109 invalid=0 releases=109 dropped=68; user also pressed outside active watch periods
diagnosis.queue_note: Old dropped counts are bounded queue overflow while not drained, not RF corruption.
diagnosis.fix: Require hardware release plus 400 ms since last valid complete frame. Existing main polls every 10 ms; no new timer or thread.
diagnosis.short_repeat_rule: No software-only timeout without hardware release; NEC short-repeat hold retained (modeled, not hardware tested).
diagnosis.tradeoff: Same-key physical presses less than 400 ms apart can merge into REPEAT.
